categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in intelligent manufacturing equipment and automation solutions. Primary business segments include: (1) Standard winding machines for basic coil production; (2) Non-standard customized winding machines and integrated production lines; (3) Special-purpose intelligent equipment and production lines; (4) Coating machines for new energy battery electrode production. The company also provides comprehensive intelligent manufacturing solutions across consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial control sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include precision winding control systems, tension control technology, and automated production line integration. Manufacturing methods employ CNC machining, precision wire cutting, and precision grinding equipment for high-precision component production. The company has developed proprietary embedded control systems (G4, G5) for intelligent equipment. Production follows a customized, order-driven model with design, machining, assembly, and debugging phases. The company maintains in-house capability for high-precision component manufacturing including shafts, fixtures, molds, and complex shaped parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customer types include manufacturers in consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, wearables), automotive industry (electric vehicles, sensors, motors), and industrial control sectors. Key end markets are consumer electronics manufacturing, automotive component production, and industrial automation. The company serves over 1,000 cumulative customers with long-term stable relationships, including major manufacturers in these sectors. Geographic markets include domestic China and international markets in Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province. Key operating locations include Jiaxing (main manufacturing facility), Shenzhen (subsidiary operations), and Jingmen (subsidiary facility). International presence includes subsidiaries in Japan (TANAC Co., Ltd.) and Malaysia (TANAKA SEIKI (MALAYSIA) SDN BHD). The company also maintains branch offices in Shenzhen and Shanghai. Domestic sales represent 96.54% of revenue while export sales account for 3.46%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures intelligent equipment and production lines that are sold directly to end-user manufacturers in consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial control industries. The company sources raw materials and components from suppliers, manufactures customized equipment, and delivers complete solutions directly to customers. The company does not operate in upstream raw material extraction or downstream retail distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Maintaining technology leadership through increased R&D investment (11.07% of revenue in 2023); (2) Expanding into emerging industries including semiconductor equipment and new energy battery production; (3) Pursuing domestic substitution opportunities in industrial automation; (4) Developing integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions combining multiple production processes; (5) Advancing control system technology with proprietary embedded systems; (6) Expanding into new application domains including autonomous vehicles and laser radar production. The company invested 150 million yuan in a semiconductor-focused investment fund and plans investment in precision machinery manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment and integrated production line solutions. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of equipment, typically upon installation, debugging, and customer acceptance. The company employs a direct sales model with customized pricing based on material costs, innovation level, technical complexity, R&D investment, customer relationship value, contract amount, and delivery timeline. Secondary revenue includes equipment maintenance and repair services, and rental income from leased facilities. The company does not utilize subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading provider of customized intelligent manufacturing solutions in China, particularly dominant in the smartphone wireless charging coil equipment segment. The company competes with both domestic and international equipment manufacturers. Key competitive advantages include: industry brand heritage dating to 1933, high market share in specific segments, comprehensive solution capabilities, strong customer relationships with over 1,000 clients, and technological leadership in precision winding and automation. The company faces competition from both established international equipment manufacturers and emerging domestic competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized intelligent equipment manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 259.9 million yuan, representing 36.43% growth from 190.5 million yuan in 2022. The company achieved profitability recovery in 2023 with net profit of 9.88 million yuan compared to a loss of 63.5 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 921.6 million yuan at year-end 2023. The company has experienced significant growth trajectory with revenue increasing from 343.9 million yuan in 2021, declining to 190.5 million in 2022, then recovering to 259.9 million in 2023. The company maintains a solid asset base and positive equity position of 676.2 million yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing comprehensive, customized intelligent manufacturing solutions that integrate multiple production processes into unified systems. Key differentiators include: (1) Proprietary precision control technologies developed over decades; (2) Ability to deliver complete production line solutions rather than standalone equipment; (3) High-precision component manufacturing capability enabling customization; (4) Strong technical support and after-sales service; (5) Industry-leading position in specific segments like wireless charging coil equipment; (6) Flexibility to adapt solutions to diverse customer requirements across multiple industries. The company emphasizes efficiency improvement, cost reduction, and quality enhancement for customer manufacturing processes.
